sloka: स्वमाश्रममिदं सौम्य राघवाणां कुलस्य हि ।आसनं पाद्यमर्ध्यं च निर्विशङ्कः प्रतीच्छ मे ।। ७.६५.६ ॥
transliteration: svamāśramamidaṁ saumya rāghavāṇāṁ kulasya hi ।āsanaṁ pādyamardhyaṁ ca nirviśaṅkaḥ pratīccha me ।। 7.65.6 ॥

translations.english: Valmiki assured Shatrughna that this hermitage was indeed like his own, belonging to the Raghu lineage, and urged him to accept the offered seat, water for feet, and respectful offering without any hesitation.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि जो राजा प्रतिदिन नगरवासियों अर्थात्‌ प्रजाजनों का काम नहीं करता, वह ऐसे भयानक नरक में डाला जाता हे, जहाँ हवा भी नहीं पहुँच पाती
